content: bgfx's own src/config.h (not bgfx.cmake) is the actual renderer-selection surface: an outer #if !defined(ANY_RENDERER_MACRO) guard means defining even ONE BGFX_CONFIG_RENDERER_* macro externally flips ALL undefined renderer macros to explicit 0 in the #else branch. So defining BGFX_CONFIG_RENDERER_VULKAN=1 alone disables D3D11/D3D12/Metal/WebGPU/GNM/AGC/NVN/OpenGLES automatically; BGFX_CONFIG_RENDERER_OPENGL must be separately set to a min-GL-version int (clamped to >=21) only on Linux. bgfx.cmake exposes no dedicated option() for this -- the mechanism is raw preprocessor defines, injected via BGFX_CMAKE_USER_SCRIPT (see next finding).
